scripts.build: npm run build -w @kirochrome/shared && npm run build -w @kirochrome/server && npm run build -w @kirochrome/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kirochrome/shared && npm run dev -w @kirochrome/server & npm run dev -w @kirochrome/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @kirochrome/web
